{{nihongo|'''Naka-Hikawa Shrine'''|中氷川神社}} is a [[shinto shrine]] in the [[Engishiki Jinmyōchō]]. It is located in [[Musashi Province]].

=== Overview ===
* It is a candidate shrine for Naka-Hikawa-sha, a {{ill|Shikinaisha|fr|Shikinaisha|zh|式內社|qid=Q134917286|lt=Shikinaisha}}. Like Ōmiya {{ill|Hikawa Shrine (Saitama)|Q703633|qid=Q703633}}, it enshrines three deities: {{ill|Susanoo-no-Mikoto|abstract|Q272993|ar|سوسانو|azb|سوسانو|bcl|Susanoo|be|Сусанаа|bg|Сусаноо|ca|Susanoo|cs|Susanoo|da|Susa-no-o|de|Susanoo|el|Σουσάνoο|eo|Susanoo|es|Susanoo|eu|Susanoo|fa|سوسانو (خدا)|fi|Susanoo|fr|Susanoo|hr|Susano|hu|Szuszanoo|hy|Սուսանո|id|Susanoo|it|Susanoo|ja|スサノオ|ka|სუსანოო-ნო-მიკოტო|ko|스사노오|la|Susano'o|lb|Susanoo|mni|ꯁꯨꯁꯅꯨ-ꯅꯣ-ꯃꯤꯀꯣꯇꯣ|nl|Susanoo|pl|Susanoo|pt|Susanoo|ro|Susanoo|rsk|Сусано|ru|Сусаноо|simple|Susanoo-no-Mikoto|sl|Susanovo|sr|Сусаноо|su|Susanoo|sv|Susanoo|ta|சுசானவோ|th|ซูซาโนโอะ|tok|jan sewi Susano|tr|Susanoo|uk|Сусаноо|vi|Susanoo-no-Mikoto|zh|素戔嗚尊|zh_min_nan|Susanoo|qid=Q272993|lt=Susanoo-no-Mikoto}}, {{ill|Kushinadahime|de|Kushinadahime|es|Kushinadahime|fr|Kushinada-hime|it|Kushinadahime|ja|クシナダヒメ|mni|ꯀꯨꯁꯤꯅꯗꯍꯤꯃꯦ|ru|Кусинада-химэ|simple|Kushinadahime|sr|Кушинадахиме|zh|櫛名田比賣|qid=Q505469|lt=Kushinadahime-no-Mikoto}}, and {{ill|Ōkuninushi|Q276944|qid=Q276944|lt=Ōnamuchi-no-Mikoto}}.

* Locally it has long been called "Hikawa-sama."

=== History ===
* Traditionally founded in the reign of Emperor Sujin.
* In late {{ill|Heian period|Q193292|qid=Q193292}}, {{ill|Yamaguchi Ietsugu|Q11466765|qid=Q11466765}} built shrine buildings. They later burned in warfare, but in the {{ill|Tenshō (Momoyama period)|Q1145058|qid=Q1145058}} era (1573-1593), {{ill|Yamaguchi Takatada|Q11467543|qid=Q11467543}} restored it together with {{ill|Yamaguchi Castle|Q11466729|qid=Q11466729|lt=Yamaguchi Castle}}.
* In {{ill|Shōwa era|ar|فترة شووا|br|Oadvezh Shōwa|ca|Període Shōwa|cs|Období Šówa|de|Shōwa-Zeit|eo|Ŝova-epoko|es|Era Shōwa|eu|Shōwa aroa|fa|دوره شووا|fi|Shōwa-kausi|fr|Ère Shōwa (1926-1989)|he|תקופת שווה|hi|शोवा युग|hu|Sóva-kor|id|Zaman Shōwa|it|Periodo Shōwa|ja|昭和|ka|შოვას პერიოდი|ko|쇼와 시대|lt|Šiova laikotarpis|ms|Zaman Shōwa|nl|Showaperiode|no|Shōwa-perioden|pl|Shōwa|pt|Período Shōwa|ru|Сёва|simple|Shōwa era|sr|Шова период|sv|Shōwa|th|ยุคโชวะ|tl|Panahong Shōwa|tr|Şova Dönemi|uk|Період Сьова|vi|Thời kỳ Chiêu Hòa|zh|昭和|zh_classical|昭和|zh_min_nan|Chiau-hô|zh_yue|昭和|qid=Q327567}} 20 ({{ill|1945|Q5240|qid=Q5240}}), Brigadier General Ken R. Dyke, first director of GHQ/CIE, inspected this shrine's festival.

===Shrine buildings / precinct===
*Honden: {{ill|Taisha-zukuri|Q387874|qid=Q387874}}, built in 1927.
*Shichisha Shrine: moved into the precincts from an area scheduled to be submerged by {{ill|Yamaguchi Reservoir|Q11467481|qid=Q11467481}}.

===Festivals===
*Spring grand festival is on the first Sunday of April; autumn grand festival is on Sports Day in October.

===Location / transportation===
*Saitama Prefecture, Tokorozawa, Yamaguchi 1849
**15 minutes on foot from {{ill|Shimo-Yamaguchi Station|Q7496941|qid=Q7496941}} on the {{ill|Seibu Sayama Line|Q1965549|qid=Q1965549}}
